events.verdict: Zeller (CHA) is in the path of Murray (DEN) when he absorbs the contact on his pick.
Morris (DEN) makes high-five contact with Parker's (CHA) hand after he has released the ball.
Jokic (DEN) is in the path of Walker (CHA) when he absorbs the contact on his pick.
Zeller (CHA) is in the path of Morris (DEN) when he absorbs the contact on the pick.
Jokic (DEN) has a resting forearm on the side of Zeller (CHA) but does not extend his arm or deliver contact that affects his shot attempt.
Zeller (CHA) is in the path of Murray (DEN) and firming up in a legal picking position when he absorbs the contact.
Morris (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position on the drive by Parker (CHA).
Morris (DEN) makes contact with Parker's (CHA) arm during the follow-through on his shot near the rim but does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
[Observable in enhanced video] The shot is imminent when Zeller (CHA) is in the paint for three seconds.
Murray (DEN) is in the path of Zeller (CHA) and absorbs the contact on the screen.
Zeller (CHA) makes marginal contact to the arm of Murray (DEN) after he releases his intended pass.
Walker (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position on the drive by Murray (DEN).
Walker (CHA) briefly grasps the shorts of Jokic (DEN) but does not affect his FOM.
Walker (CHA) makes incidental hand-on-ball contact during his swipe down and Murray (DEN) temporarily loses control of the ball during the shot.
Zeller (CHA) makes marginal contact with the hand of Murray (DEN) while making simultaneous ball contact to dislodge the ball on the rebound attempt.
Jokic (DEN) and Zeller (CHA) engage and separate on the rebound attempt.
Kidd-Gilchrist (CHA) briefly places a hand to the opposite side hip of Hernangomez (DEN) as he comes off the screen but the contact does not affect Hernangomez's SQBR.
Kidd-Gilchrist (CHA) cleanly blocks Hernangomez's (DEN) shot at the basket.
Beasley (CHA) makes clean ball contact on his initial steal attempt from Parker (CHA).
Beasley (DEN) commits a take foul on Parker (CHA).
Jokic (DEN) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Jokic (DEN) is in the path of Kidd-Gilchrist (CHA) when he absorbs the contact on the pick.
Zeller (CHA) makes marginal contact with Murray's (DEN) body that does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Murray (DEN) commits a take foul on Walker (CHA).
Jokic (DEN) is in the path of Batum (CHA) when he puts two hands to his back but does not fully extend his arms or deliver contact to dislodge him from his position.
Jokic (DEN) is not established in a screening position in Walker's (CHA) path and he continues moving into him to deliver contact.
Parker (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position and absorbs the contact on Morris' (DEN) shot near the rim.
Jokic (DEN) commits a take foul on Walker (CHA).
